rationale.overall: A is the cleaner match because B introduces an unsupported white curved artifact inside the base opening.
rationale.material: The shading is otherwise nearly identical, but A preserves the cavity’s continuous shadow and material response more convincingly.
rationale.silhouette: Both takes use essentially identical rounded-square forms and overall proportions.
rationale.smallsize: A reads slightly cleaner at reduced sizes because B’s white cavity artifact becomes a distracting bright speck.
